identity.normalizationNote: Packet entries already merge split synonyms (ID-2); every position cited is the normalized one-based position, identical to the packet index + 1.

essentialOilsOrAllergens: LAVANDULA ANGUSTIFOLIA FLOWER EXTRACT@12, ROSMARINUS OFFICINALIS LEAF EXTRACT@13 (extracts)

wLine.derivation: No class a/b/c candidate precedes the E3 marker FRAGRANCE@16 (Panthenol@32 and the preservatives come later); no alphabetical run (longest ascending run 4). The marker is a class a candidate: (i) DISODIUM LAURETH SULFOSUCCINATE@2 before it; (ii) nothing between it and the cap -> W-line = cap = 16, no fallback code.

cleansingStrength.rationale: low by C6: no prominent strong anionic; the earliest prominent cleansing surfactant is the mild anionic DISODIUM LAURETH SULFOSUCCINATE@2, with the prominent amphoteric COCAMIDOPROPYL HYDROXYSULTAINE@4. Counter-signal: three mild anionics (@2, @3, @5) against one amphoteric, plus the foam booster COCAMIDE MEA@6; confidence moderate, neighbor moderate.

conditioningLevel.rationale: high: C2 is met - early (prominent) DIMETHICONE@8, cationic polymers (POLYQUATERNIUM-7@25, -10@26, -59@42), pearlizing GLYCOL DISTEARATE@7 and humectants (PANTHENOL@32, GLYCERIN@34, SODIUM PCA@36) - and a rich architecture (W-RICH, E3 reading) holds independently: prominent payload lipids ARGAN OIL@9 and AVOCADO OIL@10 converge with the prominent silicone. Further routes: amodimethicone, dimethiconol, silicone copolymer, three cationic conditioners and four protein/amino-acid routes. Counter-signal: the cationic polymers and humectants sit after FRAGRANCE@16; the prominent silicone + oils + pearlizer core alone does not plausibly fall to moderate.

weightPotential.rationale: high: rich architecture (W-RICH) with limited reset - material payload lipids ARGAN OIL@9 and AVOCADO OIL@10 (before the W-line FRAGRANCE@16) converge with a prominent DIMETHICONE@8 and further persistent silicones (amodimethicone@29, dimethiconol@30, copolymer@24) and cationic deposition (three polyquaterniums, three cationic conditioners) in a mild C6 chassis (resetCapacity weak). The convergence route holds as well (silicone + payload_lipid + cationic_polymer + cationic_conditioner + protein_film).

excluded: ACRYLATES/PALMETH-25 ACRYLATE COPOLYMER@39 (anionic associative acrylate thickener; role named as rheology modifier, 6.4 by analogy)
SIMMONDSIA CHINENSIS (JOJOBA) SEED EXTRACT@14 (extract, not the oil)

weightPotential.counterevidence: Most cationic, amino-silicone and protein routes sit after FRAGRANCE@16 and are probably low-dose; the volatile cyclopentasiloxane is excluded.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: A prominent silicone plus two prominent oils form a rich deposit, reinforced by amino-functional silicone and multiple cationics that persist at low dose; the mild sulfosuccinate/sarcosinate/sulfoacetate + sultaine chassis does not offset them.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: moderate would need effective reset or light, non-converging routes; here at least five families converge, the prominent core (dimethicone@8, oils@9-10) is itself rich, and reset is weak.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: None material: identity exact, formula complete, recognition complete and both high routes hold; the late routes only add to an already rich prominent core.

focusPrimary.rationale: PROVISIONAL (formula-only, claims hidden): general. No claim direction is visible in the blind pass, so no specialist focus has a claim-plus-formula case yet (7.2 "unsupported/generic claims"). Formula care-direction verdict recorded for reconciliation: repair_supported. Coherent protein/keratin + amino-silicone cluster supports repair; moisture side rests mainly on oils.

careDirection.limitation: Humectants are post-fragrance (probably trace), so the moisture side is weaker than the protein/deposition side; claims decide.

focusPrimary.counterSignal: Claims hidden; the provisional value can change only through 3.2 reconciliation.
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Claim direction: null (blind). Formula compatible: n/a until a claim names a job. Decision: provisional general.

focusSecondary.decisionTrace: Empty default considered and kept: no exact-product positioning is visible in the blind pass (Section 8 condition 1 cannot be met).
focusSecondary.rationale: PROVISIONAL (formula-only): []. Secondary focus requires distinct exact-product positioning, hidden in the blind pass.

usageRole.rationale: PROVISIONAL (formula-only): regular, the default (Section 9). Every non-default trigger needs a moderate/high-graded claim or direction (CL-SRC), hidden in the blind pass. alternating impossible (not strong); treatment impossible (no active).

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: PROVISIONAL (formula-only): not_targeted, because SC1 positioning (an E2 sensitive/dry claim unit graded moderate/high) cannot be seen in the blind pass. Formula half (CSA) recorded for reconciliation: CSA would pass only through prominent payload oils (ARGAN OIL@9, AVOCADO OIL@10, E4 humectant/refatting list); there is no prominent E4 comfort route (PANTHENOL@32 is after FRAGRANCE@16), so an S-SENSITIVE gate would fail. Counter-signals: declared FRAGRANCE@16, lavender/rosemary extracts, allergens at the end.

dandruffSupport.rationale: not_supported: the complete INCI contains none of Piroctone Olamine, Climbazole, Selenium Sulfide or Selenium Disulfide (Section 11 table). Formula complete per packet (ID-1).

provisionalNotes: focusPrimary, focusSecondary, usageRole and scalpComfortTarget are claim-dependent and provisional (formula-only).
